newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: UMW stock jumps on takeover-price talk.
newsitem.headline: UMW stock jumps on takeover-price talk.

text.p: Shares of vehicle concern UMW Holdings Bhd surged on speculation over the price privately-held Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd will pay to take over the company, traders and analysts said on Monday.
Around 0700 GMT, the stock was up 1.40 ringgit or 11.29 percent to 13.80 ringgit on volume of 492,000 shares traded. The stock earlier jumped to a year high of 14.30.
UMW warrants jumped 1.00 ringgit or 15.38 percent to 7.50 ringgit on volume of 295,000.
Telecommunications firm Sapura said last week it was eyeing a stake in UMW held by state investment fund Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB), but did not mention any price.
"The rumoured price for the takeover sale by PNB to Sapura is at 14 to 16 (ringgit)," said Andrew Chuah, analyst at South Johor Securities.
Last week, the market was speculating that Sapura was offering to acquire 32 percent of PNB's total equity interest of about 45 percent in UMW, for 13 ringgit a share.

UMW makes a wide range of light and heavy equipment for use in the industrial, construction and agricultural sectors. It also assembles and markets passenger and commercial vehicles and related spares.
